name: Editly
role: Declarative JSON/CLI video editor on ffmpeg with transitions, titles and GL layers
summary: Node CLI and API that builds a video from a JSON5 spec of clips, images, audio, titles and transitions, rendering frames through headless-gl and canvas and piping them to ffmpeg. Output is one MP4 (or GIF) in one command. Distinguishing strength: the fastest route from a declarative edit list to a finished slideshow-style video without a browser. ESM only; needs ffmpeg, headless-gl on Linux.
use_when: Slideshow or montage with transitions from a JSON spec, no browser needed
Quick title-card plus clip assembly where an FFmpeg filtergraph would be tedious to hand-write
avoid_when: Alpha-aware layering or exact timing control: write the FFmpeg filtergraph directly
Browser-authored scenes: Playwright capture into FFmpeg
Anything needing long-term support: Remotion or MLT/melt are maintained
Sequence-accurate edits from a VCR timeline: FFmpeg gets resolved intervals
notes: 2026-10-26: GitHub shows v0.15.0-rc.1 (2025-01-19) but npm latest is 0.14.2 (2022-12-23); the README says the project is maintained by one person. Native headless-gl dependency may fail to build on current Node; not tested.

assessment.rationale: Last npm stable 2022-12-23; last release candidate 2025-01-19; last push 2025-05-12 (about 17 months ago). Single maintainer, native headless-gl dependency. Adds little over FFmpeg filtergraphs plus VCR's own timeline.
